subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should Control UI treat a visible, focused, freshly authorized MCP App as permitted to request one validated plain-text chat turn after the host shows the exact text for user confirmation?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but whether untrusted app content may initiate this consent flow is an intentional product security policy that requires owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve the gated boundary
options.body: Accept the current fresh-authority, foreground, validation, rate-limit, and exact-text consent controls, then land after required checks complete.

options.title: Keep apps chat-read-only
options.body: Decline ui/message support and retain MCP Apps for rendering, resource access, and authorized tool calls only.

recommendation.title: Approve the gated boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the current fresh-authority, foreground, validation, rate-limit, and exact-text consent controls, then land after required checks complete.
